# Local PDF parser fixtures

These are tiny synthetic samples generated by the already accepted, ignored G0 validation harness at `.scratch/pdf-reader/g0/embedpdf-2.15.1/`. They contain no third-party document content or user PDFs and are CC0-1.0. `password-required.pdf` uses the synthetic password `g0-reader-password`; tests intentionally do not supply it. They exercise page opening, no-text scan acceptance, encrypted-input rejection, and truncated-input rejection through the public upload HTTP seam.
